description: WITHDRAWN. Superseded by bnd-0034. Two nodes export boards with the same cluster slug and the same task slug; a merging client keys tasks by item IRI and boards by Bundle IRI, renames nothing, and expands local blocked_by slugs against the board's own origin.
note: added 2026-09-17 at rc.3 (DS-5, deferred-vector pass); unreleased, may be edited in place until the rc.3 tag
reason: Withdrawn at 1.0.0-rc.6 (PUB-6 Q55d; D100). `expanded_blocked_by` depends on "the board's own origin" (AGSC-11-15), which the vector leaves to be inferred from each board's `iri` rather than stating it. Superseded by bnd-0034, which states each board's origin in `input`.
